title: Relax-ECT Reducing Emotional Load and Anxiety before Electroconvulsive Therapy
summary: Electroconvulsive therapy is an effective and safe treatment for severe depression. However, many patients feel anxious about it because it involves a short general anaesthetic. The goal of this study is to reduce excitement and anxiety before ECT treatment by using a simple, guided meditation exercise that lasts about 10 minutes.
conditions: Severe depressive episode without psychotic symptoms
Severe depressive episode with psychotic symptoms
Bipolar affective disorder, current episode severe depression without psychotic symptoms
Bipolar affective disorder, current episode severe depression with psychotic symptoms

interventions.name: Experimental Group: ten-minute mindfulness-based breathing meditation before the 1st and 2nd ECT

Control Group: 1st ECT: ten-minute rest period without breathing meditation 
2nd ECT with delayed start: ten-minute mindfulness-based breathing meditation before the 2nd ECT

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Patients with ECT-indication due to unipolar or bipolar depression with or without psychotic symptoms (F32.3, F32.3, F31.4, F31.5).
Exclusion criteria:
Patients with ECT-indication diagnosed with a disorder in the range F20.0-F20.9. 
Insufficient German language skills.
